data.title: Grand Polo Club & Resort
data.about:
Welcome to Grand Polo Club & Resort by Emaar – a premier equestrian-inspired community set to redefine upscale living. Comprising 22 distinctive residential clusters, this masterfully planned development features expansive polo fields, state-of-the-art stables, and a clubhouse steeped in heritage. The grand entryway sets the tone for the sophisticated lifestyle within. In its highly anticipated first phase, Emaar's Grand Polo Club & Resort unveils elegant 3, 4 and 5-bedroom villas, each offering uninterrupted views of the vast green open spaces.

Ideally located just minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport, Grand Polo Club & Resort ensures both convenience and seamless connectivity. Residents will enjoy a wealth of premium amenities, including vibrant community centers, paddle courts, children’s playgrounds, and more—creating a sanctuary where every day feels like a retreat.

characteristics_module.title: Exclusive Resort Living at the Grand Polo Club & Resort by Emaar
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Equestrian-Inspired Master Community: First-of-its-kind Emaar community centered around polo, with 3 polo fields and state-of-the-art stables.
  • Unmatched Greenery and Open Spaces: Over 1.5 million sq. m. of open areas with lush green views from every villa.
  • Prime Location with Seamless Access: Located just minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport and close to Emirates Road, ensuring excellent connectivity.
  • Elegant, Family-Centric Villas: Thoughtfully designed 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas with expansive layouts, catering to both luxury and functionality.
  • Heritage-Inspired Architecture: A majestic clubhouse with a heritage-inspired design, reflecting the traditional charm of equestrian culture combined with modern elegance.
  • World-Class Lifestyle Amenities: Includes community centers, paddle courts, jogging tracks, children’s play zones, outdoor gyms, retail outlets, and a premium spa and wellness center.
  • Developed by Emaar – A Trusted Brand: Backed by one of the region’s most prestigious and reliable developers, ensuring exceptional quality, design, and ROI.

location_tile.title: Perfectly Positioned Between Urban Convenience and Natural Tranquility
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The Grand Polo Club & Resort by Emaar is strategically located at the intersection of Expo Road (E77) and Emirates Road (E611), placing it in close proximity to key destinations such as Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City. The area is well-served by public transportation, with nearby metro stations and planned infrastructure developments enhancing accessibility.

  • 5 Minutes – Al Maktoum International Airport 
  • 20 Minutes – Dubai Hills Mall 
  • 28 Minutes – Dubai Marina 
  • 35 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
